bugs.error_message: Pressing Enter to save the leaderboard name also started a dive behind the leaderboard screen
bugs.root_cause: GameScene's keydown-ENTER/SPACE handlers start a run whenever state is 'title'; the leaderboard is an HTML screen over the title, so the state was still 'title' while typing
bugs.fix: keyStart() in GameScene ignores Space/Enter when ui.typing() (an input has focus) or ui.isOpen('board'); the name field also disables Phaser keyboard capture on focus so Space can be typed
